Initial release of phy-k8s-security-audit, a static Kubernetes manifest security auditor.

- Scans YAML/JSON Kubernetes manifests for security issues based on the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.9 and Pod Security Standards.
- Detects privileged containers, host namespace use, dangerous capabilities, insecure RBAC bindings, missing resource limits/probes, plaintext secrets, missing security profiles, and more.
- Maps findings to relevant CIS and Pod Security Standards controls.
- Zero dependencies except for PyYAML.
- Requires no cluster access—audits manifests statically.
- Outputs findings with severity classification for fast remediation.
